goal: Implement the user-approved workflow hardening and explicit role model configuration

in_scope: Task engine review verdicts bound to artifact hashes, read-only status, explicit reconciliation and task holds
Lesson/assessment separation, complete template gates, scoped structural validation, CI and regression tests
Role model configuration, concise shared skill updates, usage recording and workflow documentation
out_of_scope: Authoring or resuming any lesson or curriculum task
Model benchmarking, external publication, PR merge

constraints: Use @czyboi as the single writer; keep historical task artifacts unchanged
Use additive task schema fields so historical tasks remain readable
Keep all learner-facing generated content draft and approval human-controlled
Record review findings and exact validation outcomes without fabricated token counts

definition_of_done.text: Declared outputs are committed and relevant regression, content and task validation checks pass

acceptance_criteria.text: Review completion does not imply acceptance; gated steps require clear verdicts and matching reviewed hashes. Paused tasks cannot execute. Status never writes.

New lesson tasks include plan coverage, companion assessment, actual teaching review and final rechecks. Scoped validation rejects missing selected artifacts and assessment leakage. Role models and plan pedagogy mode are explicit.
Run dependency install, content validator, unittest discovery and taskctl validate; document results, limitations and feedback disposition
